profile_text.body:
Atlassian is a for-profit, publicly traded software company (NASDAQ: TEAM) founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sydney, Australia. It develops collaboration and project management software, and its own site describes its platform as uniting teams through tools including Jira, Confluence, Loom, and Rovo AI agents for planning, tracking, and delivering work. The company reported revenue of approximately $5.215 billion for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, according to its most recent 10-K filing.

Atlassian's tracked AI products include Confluence AI, a team wiki tool incorporating smart links, automation, and Atlassian Cloud governance, and Trello AI, which adds workflow automation and AI capabilities to its project management offering. The company describes its platform as designed to support evolving standards and regulatory requirements. Both products operate under Atlassian Cloud governance.

Atlassian holds an SEC filing presence under CIK 0001650372 and trades under the ticker TEAM. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this company.
